text:
incident-bot: PAGING: billing-usage-metering token-count-anomaly detected for ingestion-shard-7. Severity: P1. Pager: PagerDuty. Alert ID: PD-98321. Links: https://pagerduty.example/PD-98321 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: Incident PD-98321 triggered by metric 'billing.metering.token_count_delta' > 5000 over 10m for shard=7. Auto-escalation in 5m if unacked.

sam (oncall): acked PD-98321. I'm on it, looking at ingestion dashboards now.

alex (billing): @sam any customer impact yet? I flagged invoices for next cycle if counts are off.

sam (oncall): initial check: only shard-7 shows negative token deltas for a subset of customers (dedicated pools). Looks like undercounting ~10-30% for ~120 customers since 06:12Z.

maria (sre): @sam can you curl the ingestion-health endpoint and post head of recent logs?

sam (oncall): running:
```
curl -s 'https://ingest.internal/api/v1/health?shard=7' | jq .
{
  "shard": 7,
  "lag_seconds": 420,
  "last_checkpoint_seq": 14923456,
  "unprocessed_batches": 23
}
```

sam (oncall): tail of metering-ingest logs (most recent):
```
[2048123456] WARN checksum-mismatch batch=17892
[2048123461] ERROR kafka-consumer retryable error: read timeout
[2048123470] INFO requeued batch=17892
[2048123490] ERROR duplicate-message-detected msg_id=abcd-1234
```

jade (platform): seeing elevated consumer lag on the consumer group for shard-7. Networking looks ok. Could be a processing hot-path regression after yesterday's platform push. I will roll back the consumer change on shard-7.

ops-automation-bot: Rollback initiated: release metering-consumer v3.18.4 -> v3.17.9 on shard-7. Triggered by jade.

sam (oncall): partial ack remains (automated ack from me). I'm going to escalate to billing eng for invoice hold decision. @alex please advise whether to hold invoices for affected customers.

alex (billing): we need quick customer risk triage. @emily can you pull list of affected customers from the token-delta report? I don't want to hold all invoices.

emily (cs): pulling report now. Query: `select customer_id, delta_pct from metering_deltas where shard=7 and start_time > '2026-03-14T06:00:00Z'`

emily (cs): got it — 117 customers, top 20 show >20% undercount; most are small SaaS teams, 3 are enterprise (cust_112, cust_497, cust_884).

alex (billing): put enterprise customers on hold for billing sync for the upcoming run. Also open a billing ticket to finance: FIN-1182.

sam (oncall): rollback completed. Consumer backlog draining, reprocessing batches. Current lag: 180s.

ops-automation-bot: Reprocessing status: 14/23 batches complete. ETA ~8m.

maria (sre): after rollback we see duplicate-message-detected errors dropping. Looks like the v3.18.4 change introduced non-idempotent requeue behavior. Need postmortem.

sam (oncall): good. Keep monitoring. I will wait for full reprocess before clearing the pager.

alex (billing): ticket FIN-1182 created, invoice hold placed for cust_112, cust_497, cust_884. Finance notified.

emily (cs): messaging plan drafted for impacted customers (apology, explain ingestion lag, invoice hold for enterprise customers). Ready for legal review.

ops-automation-bot: Reprocessing status: 23/23 batches complete. No pending backlog.

sam (oncall): verifying token deltas post-reprocess... running aggregation job: `python tools/compute_token_deltas.py --shard 7 --window 06:00-07:30`

sam (oncall): deltas back to expected range. Sample compare for cust_112 shows counts restored to within 1.5% of baseline.

maria (sre): creating ops incident PR for postmortem and roll-forward fix to make consumer requeue idempotent. Patch assigned to platform team.

alex (billing): confirm we'll un-hold invoices after end-to-end verification. I'll keep FIN-1182 open until EOD.

sam (oncall): clearing pager in 10m unless new alerts. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-98321 status changed: Resolved by sam (oncall) at 2048124010. Resolution note: rollback consumer, reprocess backlog, invoice holds for three enterprise customers. Postmortem assigned to platform + SRE teams.

sam (oncall): postmortem owners @jade @maria @alex. I'll add timeline and logs to the incident doc.

jade (platform): will start a bisect and add test coverage to avoid non-idempotent requeues. ETA PR by tomorrow.

emily (cs): customer comms queued pending legal review.

alex (billing): thanks team. I'll coordinate with finance on un-hold after final verification.

sam (oncall): closing thread. If anyone sees new token-delta alerts for shard-7, ping me immediately.
